title: Adapter tools
description: Callable Settlement surfaces for adapters. GET this list instead of scraping the homepage. Not an MCP server. Not an A2A Agent Card. Not a ChatGPT plugin.
note: Capability list only. Clients hold jobs, receipts, and balances. Liberty does not persist or take custody. money is always false. Optional demo API key is not production auth.

tools.purpose: Dry-check a transition body against the live engine and JSON Schema. Returns { ok: true } or field errors. Does not apply, persist, or mint a job id. Non-create actions must send the client-held job.
Dry-run of the transition engine. Next status and fee math. No state change. Create has no durable id. A quote is not an invoice and not proof of payment.
Commit one demo action. Client holds the job. Returns next state and fee math. Receipt on release or dispute.
One-shot create → fund → submit → release|dispute through the same engine.
Recompute fee math for a receipt or proposed release/dispute.

discovery.purpose: Ordered ready-to-run demo escrow walk (health/discovery → quote → fund → prove → release; dispute optional).
States, fees, job and receipt fields, quote / transition / simulate / verify notes.
Demo fee schedule (release 5% rounded, dispute no release fee, top-up/fund none).
Honest zeros (external users, paid pilots, revenue) plus curated listing URLs.
Recent shipped slices (newest first; dates and titles only).
Copy-ready request bodies for quote, transition, simulate, and verify.
Preset create-job fields (fill only; no auto-create or fund).
Discovery card (mode: demo, money: false). Same JSON at both paths.
OpenAPI 3.1 of the same surface. Same JSON at /openapi.json and /api/openapi.json.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /api/v0/transition bodies. Client-held demo protocol; Liberty does not move real money.

JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /api/v0/quote bodies (create / fund / submit / release / dispute). Dry-run only. A quote is not an invoice and not proof of payment. Client-held demo; Liberty does not move real money.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /api/v0/simulate bodies (one-shot create → fund → submit → release|dispute). Client-held demo protocol; Liberty does not move real money.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /api/v0/verify bodies (receipt, terminal job, or submitted job plus release/dispute). Demo only. money is always false. A verify is not custody.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for shareable terminal receipts (#receipt/r1.… / verify). Client-held demo; Liberty does not move real money. Receipts are not proof of payment.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for shareable job handoffs (#handoff/h1.…). Client-held demo; Liberty does not move real money. Handoffs are not custody transfers.
Error codes the live Settlement API returns (schema vs state, hold_expired, missing_field, illegal_transition, conflicting expiry fields). Client-held demo; Liberty does not move real money.
